meta.title: All-Time Indonesian Hits
meta.description: Indonesia's most loved artists represent every shade on the modern pop spectrum in these hit songs. Renowned rockers like Noah and Virzha deliver blazing guitars with searing melodies and gritty vocals; Maudy Ayunda and Chrisye bring heart-rending tones to orchestral ballads; Rinni Wulandari and Teddy Adhitya lay honeyed vocals under smooth, sensual R&B rhythms.
